subject: a post or a message about an event (a market, a harvest day, a tasting) that a small Israeli food business is holding

fields.prompt: the event's name, in Hebrew, as the text gives it
two or three plain Hebrew sentences: what happens, who it suits, what to bring; only from the text
one of: שוק (a market), קטיף (picking or harvest), טעימות (a tasting), אחר (anything else); null if unclear
the day it takes place, YYYY-MM-DD; work out a weekday or «מחר» from today's date; null if the text gives no day
the start time, HH:MM in 24 hours; null if not given
the end time, HH:MM in 24 hours; null if not given
the address or the name of the place, as written
the Israeli city or town, in Hebrew, as written; null if not given
the price per participant in shekels; 0 only if the text says it is free; null if not given
how many people can take part, only if the text gives a number
